scope: Strengthened mandatory-clause bound: k + sum_i(|S_i|-1) <= circuit.size + sum_{p in T.erase t0} #{i : p in S_i and |S_i|>=2}. Includes a monotone replacement interface and an actual-circuit unique-NOT/head/window/mandatory-clause bridge. The unrestricted 997 inequality is not claimed.
math_audit: Accepted986 owned gates have at least two singleton positives in support intersect the mask. They are disjoint from every empty-singleton-support prefix branch, even after mask restriction.
The selected branches lie at or before the NOT input u, so u<z excludes the exceptional constant-true replacement gate. Owned gates exclude z by definition.
Pairwise target intersection at most one and the nested two-mask family make the owned sets disjoint.
The checked minterm bound supplies k-1 empty-support branches. Adding them and z to the owned count supplies the k term.
The deletion-incidence arithmetic charges only targets of size at least two. Empty and singleton targets contribute zero to both predecessor-cardinality sums and need no payment.
The actual bridge preserves all pre-NOT values at the same indices, including malformed references evaluated by getD false. It derives the monotone hmin from the original threshold window.
No maximal-degree choice of t0, target-size lower bound, or target membership of the mandatory clause was assumed. Only t0 in T is required by the actual-circuit bridge.
